🦞 Hải Sản Đại Dương Vàng 9999 – A Must-Visit Seafood Paradise in Ha Long! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Jun 2026 • Family
🌊🦞 If you're looking for one of the best seafood restaurants in Ha Long, Hải Sản Đại Dương Vàng 9999 is an excellent choice! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The restaurant offers a huge variety of fresh and delicious seafood 🦀🦐🦑🐟, all prepared with amazing flavor and quality. Every dish is made from fresh ingredients, making every meal a truly enjoyable experience. 😋👌
What impressed us most was the friendly and hospitable staff. 😊👏 The service is professional, attentive, and always delivered with a warm smile. The restaurant is also exceptionally clean ✨, spacious 🏢, and comfortable, making it perfect for couples ❤️, families 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦, tour groups 🚌, and business gatherings 🤝.
Located in the center of Ha Long 📍 and close to the beach 🏖️, the restaurant offers a beautiful view 🌅 and a cool, relaxing atmosphere 🌴. Whether you're enjoying lunch or dinner, the setting makes the experience even more special.
The prices are very reasonable 💰 considering the quality of the food, service, and location. If you're visiting Ha Long Bay and want fresh seafood, great hospitality, and excellent value for money, Hải Sản Đại Dương Vàng 9999 is a place I highly recommend! 👍
